name: lue-ui-workspace
description: Lue UI - a platform-native, accessibility-first design system (workspace root)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.packages.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/docs
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check-tokens && pnpm check-contracts && pnpm docs-ai && pnpm check-markup && pnpm check-tools
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm docs-ai && vitest run
scripts.test:engines: pnpm build && pnpm docs-ai && vitest run --project "*(chromium)" && vitest run --project "*(firefox)" && vitest run --project "*(webkit)"
scripts.fixtures: pnpm --filter "./fixtures/*" run build && pnpm --filter "./fixtures/*" run check
